title: did:webvh as the multi-device credential for interop with mls-rs
description: Promised to Rohan Mahy and Konrad Kohbrok in Mark's email of 2026-11-18 (IETF notes/2026-11-18-mimid-interop-answers-sent.md). Part (b). did:webvh credentials are per device by construction (distinct leaves, one DID log), which avoids mls-rs's duplicate-BasicCredential refusal. Check: mls-rs carries the credential (decision mimid-1wgh.4.81.8: one opaque<V>; mls-rs decodes mimid KeyPackages), and a two-device did:webvh user shares a group with an mls-rs client; document the mls-rs side's needs.
notes:
2026-11-18 (relayed by ietf-dd): stays before the interop day; it is now the main two-device fix (4lp4.1 deferred).
2026-11-19 result (branch didwebvh-mlsrs, commit c4d8ff5; docs/didwebvh-mls-rs.md; crates/mimi-mls/tests/didwebvh_mls_rs.rs, 7 tests pass). YES with stock mls-rs d9af950, until a Commit must change the did_webvh_heads record. Works: mls-rs member + two did:webvh devices of one SCID: Welcome join, messages both ways, mimid Commit and mls-rs Commit, mls-rs adds the 2nd device; epoch authenticator and exporter agree. mls-rs app must: IdentityProvider with supported_types incl. 0x0008, validate_member = decode DIDWebVHCredential + verify log + head authorizes signature_key (mls-didwebvh crate is usable, no openmls dep), identity() = SCID + signature_key (SCID alone -> DuplicateLeafData), refuse did_webvh external senders; depend on mls-rs-core (MemberValidationContext not re-exported); extension_type(0x0006); leaf app_data_dictionary with app_components [0xF013]; the group rules (not implemented in the test). Fails: mls-rs has no AppDataUpdate and cannot emit/parse one via custom proposals (opaque<V> wrapper). Honest mls-rs member (no AppDataUpdate in capabilities) -> OpenMLS refuses every record change (UnsupportedProposalType): no new did_webvh user, no newer log, no revocation unless the Commit removes the mls-rs member. If it lists AppDataUpdate anyway -> mls-rs cannot decode the Commit (InvalidVarIntPrefix(3)), falls behind (EpochNotFound), recovers by remove+re-add. mls-rs Add needing a record change refused by mimid (ExtensionMismatch); GCE writing app_data_dictionary refused (CannotUpdateDictionaryDirectly). Draft feedback items 30 (identity per member) and 31 (AppDataUpdate requirement). Follow-up policy question: mimid-4lp4.3 (human).
